title: Nuevo Laredo Building 10,000 Homes Under Federal Vivienda para el Bienestar Program
excerpt: Construction is advancing on 10,000 homes in Nuevo Laredo under the federal Vivienda para el Bienestar program, with 980 homes now being built in colonia Toboganes and 5,000 more set to start in the coming days, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.
content:
Construction is advancing on 10,000 homes in Nuevo Laredo as part of the federal Vivienda para el Bienestar housing program, driven by the Government of Mexico through Infonavit and Conavi, in coordination with the Government of Tamaulipas and the Municipal Government of Nuevo Laredo, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

Right now, 980 homes are under construction in colonia Toboganes, in the south of the city, on a lot designated for the housing development, and construction is expected to start on 5,000 more in the coming days, according to the report.

Each home will have 60 square meters of construction, with two bedrooms, one bathroom, a living room and dining room, a kitchen, a laundry patio and parking, with the goal of offering dignified and functional spaces for Nuevo Laredo families, according to the report.

The program is aimed at workers earning one to two minimum wages, as well as people who hold housing rights and people who do not, with the goal of serving families with fewer resources, young people, women heads of household, older adults and people with disabilities, according to the report.

Land is available in different sectors in the south and west of the city, near development hubs, which will allow the program to expand until it reaches the goal of finishing the 10,000 projected homes in Nuevo Laredo in 2027, according to official information cited in the report.

Source: El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, Nov. 16, 2026.
